```{r #phase 1}
# Run the main simulation
cat("Starting Phase 1 simulation...\n")
results <- run_all_strategies()

# Save results
cat("\nSaving results...\n")
if (!dir.exists("output/results")) {
  dir.create("output/results", recursive = TRUE)
}

saveRDS(results, "output/results/phase1_results.rds")

# Create basic plots
cat("Creating plots...\n")

# Extract data for plotting
plot_data <- data.frame(
  Strategy = names(results),
  Deaths = sapply(results, function(x) x$outcomes$suicide_death_rate),
  Attempts = sapply(results, function(x) x$outcomes$suicide_attempt_rate),
  Cost = sapply(results, function(x) x$outcomes$cost_per_patient),
  QALYs = sapply(results, function(x) x$outcomes$qalys_per_patient)
)

# Death rates plot
p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Strategy, y = Deaths, fill = Strategy)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Suicide Death Rate by Strategy",
       y = "Deaths per 100,000 person-years",
       x = "Strategy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Cost vs QALYs plot
p2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = QALYs, y = Cost, color = Strategy)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Strategy), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Cost vs QALYs",
       x = "QALYs per Patient",
       y = "Cost per Patient ($)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Save plots
if (!dir.exists("output/figures")) {
  dir.create("output/figures", recursive = TRUE)
}

# ggsave("output/figures/death_rates_phase1.png", p1, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("output/figures/cost_effectiveness_phase1.png", p2, width = 8, height = 6)

cat("✓ Plots saved to output/figures/\n")

# Print summary
# cat("\n" + rep("=", 50) + "\n")
cat("PHASE 1 SIMULATION COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY\n")
# cat(rep("=", 50) + "\n\n")

cat("Key Results:\n")
baseline_deaths <- results[["No_Prediction"]]$outcomes$suicide_death_rate
acf_deaths <- results[["ACF_Intervention"]]$outcomes$suicide_death_rate
cbt_deaths <- results[["CBT_Intervention"]]$outcomes$suicide_death_rate

cat(sprintf("• Baseline suicide death rate: %.2f per 100,000\n", baseline_deaths))
cat(sprintf("• ACF intervention reduces deaths by: %.2f per 100,000\n", baseline_deaths - acf_deaths))
cat(sprintf("• CBT intervention reduces deaths by: %.2f per 100,000\n", baseline_deaths - cbt_deaths))

cat(sprintf("\nFiles saved:\n"))
cat("• Results: output/results/phase1_results.rds\n")
cat("• Plots: output/figures/\n")
cat("\nReady to proceed to Phase 2 (Full Model Implementation)!\n")


```

```{r}
# Verify our risk distribution matches paper's target
risk_strata <- create_risk_strata(100)
expected_attempts_per_100k <- sum(risk_strata$baseline_attempt_rate * 
                                 risk_strata$proportion_pop) * 100000
print(paste("Expected attempts per 100k:", expected_attempts_per_100k))


# Test transition matrix for highest risk stratum
high_risk <- risk_strata[stratum_id == 100]  # Highest risk
test_matrix <- create_transition_matrix(high_risk)
print("High risk transition matrix:")
print(test_matrix)
print(paste("Attempt probability:", test_matrix[1,2]))
```
